title: The Happy Little Tree
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and soaks things in, and tonight’s psalm is about a tree that drinks from the river every day: Wren asks for one more scripture story each night, and the stories grow in her heart until she knows what to do for a sad friend.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she loves to soak in Heavenly Father’s words. In Wren’s world today: every night, Wren asks for one more scripture story before bed. Little by little, those stories are growing in her heart like water helps a tree. When a friend was sad, Wren remembered a story about kindness and knew just what to do. Just like the happy tree by the river, Wren is growing strong and good from Heavenly Father’s words.
